title: Fake News on Social Media
text:
Many people read news on social media every day. Social media is fast, but not all news on it is true. Some stories are fake news. A fake story can look real, with a photo and a title that makes you click.

Before you share a story, check where it comes from. Look at other websites too. If only one site writes about it, be careful. Good readers think before they share.
